assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor
The symptoms are of a non-sustained nature
There is a need for extended rhythm correlation
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring is intended to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period
The service is medically necessary to diagnose the underlying cause of the patient's palpitations and irregular heartbeat
